CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_categoria_relacion" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "codigo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(500),
  "id_categoria_relacion" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "orden" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_categoria_relacion")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_invitado" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "cantidad_pases" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "es_titular" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "id_categoria_relacion" int4,
  "id_invitado" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_invitado_titular" uuid,
  "id_matrimonio" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_persona_natural" int4 NOT NULL,
  "lado_relacion" text DEFAULT 'AMBOS' NOT NULL,
  "observaciones" character varying(1000),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_invitado"),
  CONSTRAINT "iv_invitado_lado_relacion_check_97f471a8" CHECK ("lado_relacion" IN ('NOVIA', 'NOVIO', 'AMBOS', 'OTRO'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_invitado_requerimiento_alimentario" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "detalle" character varying(500),
  "id_invitado" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_invitado_requerimiento_alimentario" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_requerimiento_alimentario" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_invitado_requerimiento_alimentario")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_mesa" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "capacidad" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_matrimonio" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_mesa" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "numero" int4,
  "observaciones" character varying(1000),
  "ubicacion" character varying(250),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_mesa")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_mesa_invitado" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_invitado" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_mesa" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_mesa_invitado" uuid NOT NULL,
  "numero_asiento" int4,
  "observacion" character varying(500),
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_mesa_invitado")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_requerimiento_alimentario" (
  "activo" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "codigo" character varying(50) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "descripcion" character varying(500),
  "id_requerimiento_alimentario" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "nombre" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_requerimiento_alimentario")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_rsvp" (
  "cantidad_asistentes_confirmados" int4,
  "confirmacion_digital" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado_rsvp" text DEFAULT 'PENDIENTE' NOT NULL,
  "fecha_confirmacion_digital" timestamptz,
  "fecha_respuesta" timestamptz,
  "fecha_verificacion_manual_1" timestamptz,
  "fecha_verificacion_manual_2" timestamptz,
  "id_invitado" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_rsvp" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_usuario_verificacion_manual_1" int4,
  "id_usuario_verificacion_manual_2" int4,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "verificacion_manual_1" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "verificacion_manual_2" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_rsvp"),
  CONSTRAINT "iv_rsvp_estado_rsvp_check_7c306183" CHECK ("estado_rsvp" IN ('PENDIENTE', 'CONFIRMADO', 'NO_ASISTE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."iv_rsvp_historial" (
  "canal" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "estado_anterior" text,
  "estado_nuevo" text NOT NULL,
  "fecha_cambio" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id_rsvp" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_rsvp_historial" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id_usuario" int4,
  "observacion" character varying(1000),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id_rsvp_historial"),
  CONSTRAINT "iv_rsvp_historial_canal_check_d6e88a8a" CHECK ("canal" IN ('MANUAL', 'DIGITAL', 'SISTEMA')),
  CONSTRAINT "iv_rsvp_historial_estado_anterior_check_87ee2fda" CHECK ("estado_anterior" IN ('PENDIENTE', 'CONFIRMADO', 'NO_ASISTE')),
  CONSTRAINT "iv_rsvp_historial_estado_nuevo_check_37200580" CHECK ("estado_nuevo" IN ('PENDIENTE', 'CONFIRMADO', 'NO_ASISTE'))
)
